question: Name the longest highway single-tube tunnel that reduces the travel time and overall distance between Manali and Keylong.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Tunnel.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Tunnel **is the** longest highway single-tube tunnel** in the world and is located in the **Rohtang Pass of the Himalayas** in** Himachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• It reduces the travel distance between **Manali and Keylong **by **46 km** and the** travel time **by around **4-5 hours.**
 
• The tunnel is named after former Indian Prime Minister **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**, who initiated the project in** 2002.**
 
• The construction of the tunnel was a challenging task due to the tough terrain and adverse weather conditions, but it was completed in a record time of **10 years.**
 
• The tunnel is a significant infrastructure development that not only provides a **better connectivity** but also boosts the economy of the region by promoting** tourism and trade.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Natuwadi Tunnel** is a proposed tunnel.

 
 
• It will connect the **Natuwadi ghat of Maharashtra** with the **Konkan coast.**
 
 
 
• **Karbude Tunnel** is a railway tunnel.
 
 
• It is located in the **Ratnagiri** **district of Maharashtra**, India.
 
 
 
• **Jawahar Tunnel** is a road tunnel located in the** Pir Panjal range of Jammu and Kashmir,** India.
 
 
• It connects **Srinagar with Jammu.**
